extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology from XML results, methods, and figure captions; previous pending-review placeholder claims were replaced with bounded direct-assay mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Cp1 and melittin in E. coli UB1005; Cp1 is the paper lead peptide
mechanism_claims.claim_text: NPN uptake assays support outer membrane permeabilization by Cp1 and melittin, with concentration-dependent differences described in the source text.
direct_assay_types: NPN uptake outer membrane permeability assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Quantitative curve values are figure-level; local text supports direction and assay type, not a full numeric curve extraction.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Cp1 and melittin in E. coli UB1005
mechanism_claims.claim_text: ONPG assays support increased inner membrane permeability after peptide treatment at 1x MIC and 1/2 MIC.
direct_assay_types: ONPG beta-galactosidase inner membrane permeability assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Use as membrane-permeability evidence only; no independent molecular receptor target is established.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Cp1 and melittin in E. coli UB1005
mechanism_claims.claim_text: diSC3-5 assays show cytoplasmic membrane depolarization after peptide treatment, while the source explicitly cautions that depolarization was not required for strong antimicrobial activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not overstate depolarization as the sole or necessary killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Cp1 and melittin in E. coli ATCC 25922
mechanism_claims.claim_text: PI flow cytometry supports bacterial membrane damage after treatment; source text reports higher stained-cell fraction for melittin than Cp1 at 1x MIC.
direct_assay_types: propidium iodide flow cytometry membrane integrity assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: PI staining is interpreted as membrane damage/cell death; it is not evidence for sequence-specific nucleic-acid binding.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Cp1 and melittin in E. coli ATCC 25922
mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM/TEM figure panels provide qualitative structural evidence of membrane/cell envelope disruption after peptide treatment at 1x MIC.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Qualitative image evidence; no additional numerical membrane-damage value was fabricated from local images.

unsupported_claims_not_promoted.reason: PI is a membrane-damage/cell-death readout in this paper, not a nucleic-acid target-binding assay.

tools_attempted: rg over XML/PDF extracted text for activity/toxicity/mechanism phrases
